$comment: Official TED and World Bank notices checked on 18 November 2026. build-tenders.js merges this file. scripts/refresh-public-tenders.js re-checks deadlines against the public APIs. Do not add TendersOnTime rows. ADB and AfDB are allowlisted; none were reachable for this seed.

notices.title: Swissgrid large power transformer bundle
notices.summary: Swissgrid AG has TED contract notice 571847-2026 for an LPT bundle of large power transformers. TED gives the submission deadline as 25 January 2027 at 23:59 UTC+1. The notice was published on 18 August 2026.

notices.title: St Gallen six 40 MVA regulating transformers
notices.summary: The municipal utility of St Gallen has TED contract notice 633731-2026 for six regulating transformers rated 40 MVA ONAN and 50 MVA ONAF at 110/10/20 kV. TED gives the submission deadline as 15 January 2027 at 16:00 UTC+1. TED lists the same buyer, title and deadline on 604807-2026 and 618386-2026, and this record links the latest publication number.

notices.title: North Macedonia power block transformer replacement
notices.buyer: AD Elektrani na Severna Makedonija - Skopje
notices.summary: AD Elektrani na Severna Makedonija in Skopje has TED contract notice 676522-2026 to replace power block transformers. TED gives the submission deadline as 24 November 2026 at 09:30 UTC+1. The notice was published on 1 October 2026.

notices.title: Cheb 110/22 kV substation
notices.buyer: Státní investiční a rozvojová společnost, a.s.
notices.summary: The Czech state investment company has TED contract notice 686867-2026 for a 110/22 kV substation at the Cheb strategic business park. TED gives the submission deadline as 20 November 2026 at 13:00 UTC+1. The notice was published on 6 October 2026.

notices.title: Gasunie compact distribution-transformer stations
notices.summary: Nederlandse Gasunie has TED contract notice 705480-2026 for compact stations under the distribution-transformer heading. TED gives the submission deadline as 18 November 2026 at 10:00 UTC+1. The notice was published on 13 October 2026.

notices.title: wesernetz Bremen high-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear
notices.summary: wesernetz Bremen GmbH has TED qualification notice 713310-2026 for 110 kV, 20 kV and 10 kV switchgear and electrical installation. TED gives the participation deadline as 20 November 2026 at 12:00 UTC+1. The notice was published on 15 October 2026.

notices.title: HEP Fazana third 35/20 kV transformer
notices.summary: HEP operator of the distribution system has TED contract notice 716522-2026 to install a third 35/20 kV transformer at the Fazana 35/10 kV substation. TED gives the submission deadline as 23 November 2026 at 10:00 UTC+2. The notice was published on 16 October 2026.

notices.title: Kleszczow municipal electricity network equipment
notices.summary: Gmina Kleszczow has TED contract notice 720657-2026 for supply and installation of equipment to extend the municipal electricity network. TED gives the submission deadline as 24 November 2026 at 10:00 UTC+1. The notice was published on 19 October 2026.

notices.title: EDM Mozambique transformers and low-voltage distribution boards
notices.summary: Electricity of Mozambique has World Bank invitation OP00481662, reference MZ-EDM-554191-GO-RFB, to supply transformers and low-voltage distribution boards. The notice prints the deadline as 2:00 pm local time on 26 January 2027 at the Maputo address, stored here as 14:00 UTC+2. The World Bank notice date is 16 November 2026.

notices.title: Syria high-voltage substation transformer package
notices.buyer: The Public Establishment for Transmission and Distribution of Electricity
notices.summary: The Public Establishment for Transmission and Distribution of Electricity has World Bank invitation OP00480092, reference SY-PETDE-510612-CW-RFB, for high-voltage substations including 3 x 300 MVA, 9 x 125 MVA and 17 x 30 MVA transformers named on the bid. The notice states bids are due at 12:00 noon Damascus time on 3 February 2027. The World Bank notice date is 8 November 2026.

notices.title: Eswatini distribution transformers meters and ready boards
notices.summary: Eswatini Electricity Company has World Bank invitation OP00477375, reference SZ-ECC-575165-GO-RFB, to supply distribution transformers, electricity meters and ready boards. The notice prints 11:00 am on 30 December 2026 and does not print a UTC offset, so this record uses UTC+2, the civil time in Eswatini. The World Bank notice date is 27 October 2026.
